newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks nudge higher in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks nudge higher in London trading.

text.p: Japanese stocks were modestly higher in London on Tuesday, with interest focused on companies which recently announced earnings, traders said.
"People have been chasing those stocks which have had earnings out, just as they were in Tokyo," said a trader at one leading Japanese brokerage here.
The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese shares traded in London was up 6.92 points or 0.5 percent at 1,437.79, after the Nikkei 225 in Tokyo gained 159.81 points or 0.8 percent to 20,956.18.

TDK was marked slightly higher after first-half figures, quoted at 6,820 yen in London from 6780 in Tokyo, while Kyocera was quoted at 7,320 yen from 7,330 in Tokyo after posting a drop in first-half profits.
Traders said the Nikkei 225 could extend its gains on Wednesday on the back of continued Wall Street strength.
"We could have a crack at 21,000 on the Nikkei tomorrow and they we will see if it holds above there," the trader said.
